# Furniture Hub Dhangadhi — AI-Readable Overview
> Handcrafted wooden furniture, modern sofas, dining tables, and office seating in Dhangadhi, Kailali, Sudurpashchim, Nepal.
> फर्निचर हब धनगढी — धनगढी, कैलालीमा काठको गुणस्तरीय फर्निचर, सोफा, टेबल र कुर्सी पसल।

## About Furniture Hub Dhangadhi
Furniture Hub Dhangadhi is a furniture showroom and retailer located on Main Road / Hasanpur, Ward 1, Dhangadhi, Kailali, Sudurpashchim Pradesh, Nepal (Coordinates: 28.6967° N, 80.5882° E). The store provides modern, durable wooden furniture for residential living rooms, bedrooms, dining areas, and office work environments across Sudurpashchim.

The store carries curated handcrafted pieces including executive office chairs, contemporary lounge sofas, solid wood dining tables, minimalist benches, side tables, ceramic decor, and indoor plants. Customers can browse products on the online catalog at https://www.furniturehubdhangadhi.com or order directly through instant WhatsApp messaging.

## Core Products & Collections (English & नेपाली)
- Seatings & Chairs: Ergonomic office chairs (Argo Office Chair), Valentina accent chairs, and Nordic minimalist benches. (कार्यालय कुर्सी, एक्सेन्ट कुर्सी, काठको बेन्च)
- Combos & Ensembles: Living room sofa and companion coffee table ensembles (Sofa Decor Combo). (कम्बो फर्निचर)
- Surfaces & Dining: Scandinavian dining tables, Winnie side tables, and coffee surfaces built with solid timber finishes. (डाइनिङ टेबल, साइड टेबल)
- Long Sofas: Contemporary curved lounge sofas (Zenith Curved Lounge Sofa) engineered with high-resilience memory foam. (लाउन्ज सोफा सेट)
- Decorations & Greens: Artisan ceramic vases, Halo arch floor lamps, and botanical indoor plants. (घर सजावट, इनडोर प्लान्ट, ल्याम्प)

## Key Store Services
- Delivery Across Sudurpashchim: Vehicle delivery across Dhangadhi, Attariya, Tikapur, Mahendranagar, and surrounding Kailali/Kanchanpur areas.
- Direct Craftsmanship: Pieces built with kiln-dried hardwoods, pine, and durable steel/leatherette upholstery.
- WhatsApp Assisted Ordering: Real-time product photos, dimension inquiries, and order handoff via WhatsApp.
- Flexible Payment Methods: Cash on Delivery, eSewa, Khalti, and direct bank transfers accepted upon order confirmation.
